Heard the counsel for the petitioners and the A.G.A. representing the respondent Nos. 1 to 3.

The present petition has been filed for the following relief:-
"(i) issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 30.06.2025, registered as Case Crime No.570/2025,
Under Sections 318, 319, 338, 336, 340, 274, 275 (B.N.S.), 2023 and under Section 59 Pramod Kumar Gupta @ Raja Gupta vs State Of Uttar Pradesh And 3 Others on 11 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111553002/
1 Food Safety and Standards Act 2006, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District-Banda."

sentences.text: A perusal of the First Information Report discloses commission of offence in the above case.
In view of the aforesaid, no case for quashing the first information report is made out.
For the aforesaid reason, the present writ petition is dismissed.
